summary: Stronger isolation: the part of PIM Manager that is reachable from the internet now holds only its own data.

fixes.title: Web app keeps only its own data
fixes.text: The web app holds no right to start or change the engine's job and reads no Key Vault secret except the break-glass passphrase hash. Commit and Run now start at the engine's next scheduled run, within five minutes.

fixes.title: Rights checked on every update
fixes.text: Each update checks the web app's rights and reports any right it must not hold as a security finding.
